kv13.8:1.3: dukkhābhinandino sattā atthi keci dukkhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, dukkhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantī’ti.
kv13.8:1.5: nanu sukhābhinandino sattā atthi keci sukhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, sukhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhantī’ti.
kv13.8:1.7: hañci sukhābhinandino sattā atthi keci sukhaṃ patthenti pihenti esanti gavesanti pariyesanti, sukhaṃ ajjhosāya tiṭṭhanti, no ca vata re vattabbe:
kv13.8:2.3: dukkhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, sukhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetī’ti.
kv13.8:2.5: nanu sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anusetī’ti.
kv13.8:2.7: hañci sukhāya vedanāya rāgānusayo anuseti, dukkhāya vedanāya paṭighānusayo anuseti, no ca vata re vattabbe
kv13.8:3.5: “so evaṃ anurodhavirodhaṃ samāpanno yaṃ kiñci vedanaṃ vediyati. sukhaṃ vā dukkhaṃ vā adukkhamasukhaṃ vā, so taṃ vedanaṃ abhinandati abhivadati ajjhosāya tiṭṭhatī”ti
